title: God as King
definition: God as King means that He reigns with supreme authority over all creation, nations, history, and His people.
summary: God's kingship calls for worship, obedience, reverence, and trust.
christFocus: Jesus is the promised King whose kingdom will never end.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's kingship calls for worship, obedience, reverence, and trust.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
